facts.label: Excesso e suficiência
facts.sub: Too + adjetivo mostra excesso: too cold to swim. Adjetivo + enough mostra o suficiente: warm enough. Com a negativa, not warm enough quer dizer que falta calor.

facts.label: Demais
facts.sub: Too + adjetivo mostra excesso: The water is too cold. Para dizer o que não dá para fazer, acrescente to + verbo: It’s too cold to swim. Não use too much antes de adjetivo.

facts.label: Suficiente
facts.sub: Enough vem depois do adjetivo: warm enough, big enough. Com to + verbo, mostra a ação possível: I’m warm enough to enjoy the walk. É o oposto de too em muitas situações.

items.s: Too means more than you want.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: Too means more than you want. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Enough comes before the adjective. → Falso (It comes after: warm enough.)
“Too cold to swim” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A gray beach · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a gray Saturday morning on the coast near Portland. The beach is almost empty, and the sky is full of clouds. Rex stands on the sand with a towel in his hand. His friend Ana arrives in a small jacket. They planned a day at the sea. Rex asks if she wants to swim.
“Ana, do you want to swim? The beach looks nice.” says Rex. “No way. The water is too cold to swim in.” says Ana. “Really? I think it’s warm enough for me.” says Rex.
